mechanics_notes: 1) POST-CUTOFF CLASS: Valkyrie released globally August 20, 2025. All mechanics sourced from Maxroll build guide fetched 2026-07-15. Conf ceiling 0.8 on mechanically-derived fields due to post-cutoff status. 2) The Z→X LOCK mechanic (cannot use Z again until X fires) creates a committed burst sub-cycle unusual in LA — most identity skills can be activated independently. This lock-and-release structure is a distinctive design pattern. 3) Valkyrie explicitly combines DPS and party support: Shining Knight (DPS-primary) still applies Synergy debuff (party amplification). The party contribution is a rider, not a primary — but it makes Shining Knight more party-valuable than typical pure DPS. 4) Ark Grid dependency: Maxroll guide notes specific Ark Grid node combinations (Final Words + Knight of Finality) optimize the loop. Ark Grid is a separate system not captured in this schema — flag as mechanics-gap. 5) Light Meter fill via 15 skills = one of the cleaner meter designs in LA: skill-count-based rather than damage-based fill, making meter prediction reliable regardless of target HP. geo_text: Liberator Valkyrie is a group-support identity. Circle of Truth applies +10% damage enemy Brand. Seraphic Leap and Seraphic Oath provide party attack power buffs. Blessing of Salvation and Salvation Site provide shields and damage reduction. Release Light (Z) grants Liberator stacks (damage buffs); Light of the Faithful (X) consumes stacks for ally healing (+10% per stack). The entire spatial identity is 'stand near party and deliver buffs/heals via skill rotation.'

economy.plain_text: DUAL ECONOMY: (1) Light Meter fills via skills → unlocks identity skill access. (2) Release Light (Z) builds Liberator stacks (each stack = +10% damage dealt buff for 60s, max 3). Light of the Faithful (X) spends stacks for healing (+10% healing per stack consumed). The identity choices Z vs X represent a tension: build stacks for damage amplification vs spend stacks for healing. This dual-spend mechanic on a shared stack resource is a richer support economy than most LA support classes.

Solo DPS capability is minimal. C2 ruling prediction: system-record/negative for solo. 3) The Z→X mechanic is inverted vs Shining Knight: in Liberator, Z GENERATES stacks (defensive/support resource) while X SPENDS them (healing output). The direction of the stack economy (build-to-heal vs Shining Knight's build-to-burst) is the core design fork between the two identities. 4) 'Generates damage buff stacks that can be converted to healing' is a genuinely novel support economy in the genre — a class that builds offensive potential then can choose to convert it to party defense.
